lines.en: I walk slowly through the dead grass

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩过干裂的土
lines.en: My hooves cross the cracked earth

lines.zh: 我低头找还能吃的草根
lines.en: I lower my head for roots still edible

lines.zh: 我边走边嚼嘴里的草根
lines.en: I chew roots as I walk
I round the dead tree
My horns catch a low branch
I keep a steady step

lines.zh: 我停在裂缝边看了一会儿
lines.en: I stop at a crack and look down
I follow the dry riverbed
My shadow is long, and so is the grass
I move into the shade
I walk slowly because it's hot

lines.zh: 我嗅着地面，换了个方向
lines.en: I sniff the ground and change direction
Dead grass rustles under my feet

lines.zh: 我走向远处那一点点绿
lines.en: I head for the small patch of green

lines.zh: 我一边走一边回头看你
lines.en: I walk and keep glancing back at you
I stand, tail swinging gently
I've chewed a long while and still not swallowed
I raise my head and my ears twitch
Wind comes off the waste, very dry
I press my face to a tuft of grass

lines.zh: 这里能吃的东西不多了
lines.en: There's little left to eat here
I lick my own nose
I smell the faintest trace of water
I paw twice at the sand
A bug flies out of the dry grass
A few stalks hang on my horns
I blink once, slowly
This quiet is too much
I shift my stance
I hear steps far off
I look that way
You smell of water
I don't flee, but I don't come closer

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在看你手里的东西
lines.en: My eyes are on what you're holding
Walk slowly and I'll follow

lines.zh: 这里已经没什么可吃的
lines.en: There's nothing left to eat here
Which way are you going

lines.zh: 我的角不是用来伤人的
lines.en: My horns aren't for hurting
Don't come from behind
I turn aside to make room
This whole area is parched

lines.zh: 你的脸色不好，也是渴了吗
lines.en: You look bad; thirsty too
Neither of us needs to fear the other
I stumble back
I let out a rough breath
I tip sideways, horns askew

lines.zh: 被打的地方毛掉了一块
lines.en: A patch of coat is gone where I was hit
I lower my head to guard my chest
I retreat behind the dead tree

lines.zh: 饥饿原野的灰，从我背上落下。
lines.en: Ash of the starved plains falls off my back.
I turn on four stiff legs
The legs I stand on are shaking
I cough twice, dry
Is that grass? Fresh
I smell water

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子还是绿的
lines.en: The leaves in your hand are still green

lines.zh: 给我一点，我很久没吃了
lines.en: Give me some; I haven't eaten in ages
I come slowly; I won't snatch
It's not enough, but thank you
Just set the water down
My lips ache from dryness

lines.zh: 我闻着这味道就精神了
lines.en: The smell alone wakes me up
Have you brought anything else
I'm not picky; dry will do
Let me smell it once more
Back off a little, then I'll eat
This water is better than anything
I drink in slow mouthfuls

lines.zh: 这一片地要是有水就好了
lines.en: If only this land had water
You bump me and I sway
My horns nearly catch you
I step back onto a snapping twig
You squeeze past my flank
We bump, neither of us heavy
I lower my head and yield

lines.zh: 你碰到我的肋，我抖了一下
lines.en: You touch my ribs and I shudder

lines.zh: 我的细尾巴拂过你小腿
lines.en: My thin tail brushes your calf

lines.zh: 这一下把我推得转了半圈
lines.en: That turns me half around
I steady myself before moving
Another comes from behind the dead tree
We sniff each other
Its horns are shorter than mine

lines.zh: 饥饿原野的草，我们四只分。
lines.en: Four of us share this starving plain.

lines.zh: 它把最好的一丛让给我
lines.en: It gives me the best tuft
We walk side by side
Its ribs show too
We press close for warmth
This land can't feed two
Still, we go together
I take it up in my mouth
This has no flavour at all
I chew twice and spit it out

lines.zh: 我用头把它顶到你脚边
lines.en: I butt it to your feet
This can't be eaten at all

lines.zh: 这东西沾了土，我用鼻尖拱开。
lines.en: This thing is soiled; I nudge it away with my nose.
It rolls into the crack
I carry it a few steps
It's too hard to bite

lines.zh: 这口东西太硬，我松开了。
lines.en: This mouthful is too hard; I let it go.
You're coming too fast
I back away, but I don't run
My horns come down
This land is empty enough
I don't want to fight here
Don't push me too far
I scrape the dirt with a forehoof

lines.zh: 我们之间没有水，也没有草
lines.en: Between us there's no water, no grass

lines.zh: 我肋骨底下一阵阵发紧
lines.en: My ribs are heaving
Then bring it on
I circle you, keeping my distance
My horns stay pointed at you

lines.zh: 我缩着脖子，盯着你的手。
lines.en: Neck drawn in, I watch your hands.
I retreat behind the dead tree
The ground under me is loose
I'm looking for a way to run
I tuck my scrawny neck into my shoulders
Don't come any closer
I cough once, dryly
If I go down, it'll be here
I butt you with my horns
It isn't heavy; only a push
I rear and strike with a forehoof

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我立刻退三步
lines.en: You fall back two steps; I fall back three

lines.zh: 我撞在你护甲上，自己晃了
lines.en: I hit your armor and stagger myself

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口扯了一下
lines.en: I catch your cuff and tug

lines.zh: 我这一下打空了，差点跌倒
lines.en: I miss and nearly fall
My horn wedges in a seam of your armor
I wrench my head free

lines.zh: 我的角擦过你，马上收势。
lines.en: My horn grazes you; I pull back at once.
Something moves at the far side of the dead grass
I rise from beside the crack

lines.zh: 我的肋骨在皮下一根根
lines.en: My ribs show under the hide

lines.zh: 这里没有水，可我还是来了
lines.en: There's no water, yet here I am
I lower my head and look for grass first
Wind lifts my coat
Dry grass hangs on my horns
I walk step by step into the clearing

lines.zh: 我抬起枯瘦的头望见你
lines.en: I lift my gaunt head and see you
I read the smells in the wind
Fire catches me and I skip away

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，摔在石上
lines.en: I slide down a slope and hit stone

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我猛地抬头
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I jerk my head up

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻在干草里
lines.en: The blast flips me into the dry grass
An arrow sinks into my flank

lines.zh: 那股力气钻进骨头，我跪下。
lines.en: That force soaks into my bones; I kneel.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，骨头都软了
lines.en: Hungry so long my bones feel soft

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我跪了下去
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I go down

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我蹬不到东西
lines.en: No earth below; my hooves find nothing
